act.name: Disaster Management Act, 2005
act.source_authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing disaster-management authorities, planning, relief standards, response powers and offences.

sections.title: Guidelines for minimum standards of relief.
sections.text: Section 12 concerns guidelines for minimum standards of disaster relief; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: The National Authority recommends minimum relief standards covering shelter, food, water, medical care and special assistance.
